annotations.title: A wallet's trades in an NFT collection

description: The entries (purchases) and exits (sales) of one wallet in one NFT collection: asset, price (ADA), time and transaction. Entries are found by the wallet's stake key, exits through the listings it made; the answer says what it does not cover.
